Name: Spine
Description: This will create a Simpler IK FK Spine System

attrs.Help_string: What this block does: This will create a Simpler IK FK Spine System. How to use it: fill the key fields below before build. SetParent: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4). SetGameParent: set the node/object name this block should use. Tip: start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need. Template parent examples: Spine_End_Jnt, Spine_Inv_Jnt, Spine_F_Jnt.
